g.text: Coherent truncated cores: constructed-state quality and full native sampling cost
Core TV excludes finite-native RNG/rounding/global failure integration. Retained TV includes its enumerated failure mass. * Separate m=12 supplement.
Cost: median of all 3 predetermined cold processes; whiskers show min–max. Shared host, one thread. Missing cells and failed runs are not replaced.
m=32 shows resource/cost feasibility and a nominal state-tail budget only; no large-mode quality-cost or exact-GBS efficiency claim.
